name: atk-stock-manager-electron
description: Aplikasi Stock ATK/ARK menggunakan Electron dan Python/Flask

scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others "npm run start-backend" "npm run start-frontend" "cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run electron-dev"
scripts.package: npm run build-frontend && electron-packager . ATK-Stock-Manager --overwrite --asar=true --platform=win32 --arch=x64 --icon=icon.ico --prune=true --out=release-builds --version-string.CompanyName=CE --version-string.FileDescription=CE --version-string.ProductName="ATK Stock Manager"
